title: Callaway Chart Editor: persist saved edits as localStorage user-defaults

requirements.summary: Persist “Save Changes” from the Callaway Chart Editor as the new localStorage user-default grid charts so reloads and “Reset to Defaults” use the latest saved defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking “Save Changes” in the Callaway Chart Editor for 9 holes, reloading the page shows the saved 9-hole chart values without requiring any additional action.
After clicking “Save Changes” in the Callaway Chart Editor for 18 holes, reloading the page shows the saved 18-hole chart values without requiring any additional action.
Clicking “Reset to Defaults” restores the chart to the latest saved defaults (from localStorage), not necessarily the original hard-coded defaults.

If the app is opened in a browser where no chart defaults exist in localStorage yet, the app initializes the localStorage defaults from the current hard-coded defaults and behaves the same as today (no user-visible regression).

file_operations.description: Introduce a distinct persistence concept for grid charts: (1) user-default grid charts (stored in new localStorage keys) and (2) active/edited grid charts (stored in the existing grid keys). Add safe initialization that seeds the user-default keys from the hard-coded defaults when missing; ensure invalid JSON is ignored and cleared consistent with existing validation behavior.

Update Save/Reset behaviors: on “Save Changes”, persist the current 9/18 grid chart as both the active/edited chart and the user-default chart so future loads use it by default; on “Reset to Defaults”, restore the editor state from the latest user-default chart (and update/clear the active/edited storage accordingly). Continue using existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Tabs, Alert) for the UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Separate localStorage keys for user-default vs active/edited grid charts and update chart resolution order to prefer active → user-default → hard-coded defaults, clearing invalid stored JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: A new pair of localStorage entries exists for storing the user-default grid charts for both 9 and 18 holes (distinct from the existing active/edited grid chart keys).
`getActiveGridChart(9|18)` resolves charts in this order: active/edited grid chart (if present and valid) → user-default grid chart (if present and valid) → hard-coded default grid chart.
If any stored chart JSON is invalid, it is ignored and cleared (preserving the current validation behavior).

file_operations.description: Add new localStorage keys for user-default grid charts (9 and 18) and refactor functions to explicitly load/save/clear both active and user-default grid charts. Update `getActiveGridChart(9|18)` (and any dependent chart selection logic for display/calculation) to resolve in order: active/edited → user-default → hard-coded, and to clear invalid stored JSON for both key types.

Wire the editor’s runtime selection to the updated persistence layer: ensure initial state uses the updated `getActiveGridChart`, and ensure reset behavior matches the new resolution/fallback rules (restoring from user-defaults rather than always hard-coded). Continue using existing shadcn-ui components already in this view; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
